title: White-Box Evidence, Interpretability, and Activation Governance
subtitle: Internal-state observations should enter governance only as typed evidence artifacts with lineage, method assumptions… explicit non-authority; white-box evidence complements but does not replace behavioral and operational evidence.

display.problem: Behavioral tests can reveal what a model did without identifying… interpretability methods can themselves generate persuasive but unstable stories.
display.insufficient: A probe, visualization, sparse feature label, attribution map, or circuit… model/version/data regime, and compared with plausible alternative explanations.

mechanism.label: Evidence packet containing model
mechanism.detail: Define an evidence packet containing model hash… method version, feature/circuit identifiers, assumptions, and confidence.

mechanism.label: Separate observational association
mechanism.detail: Separate observational association, predictive decoding, causal necessity, causal sufficiency, and completeness claims.

mechanism.label: Held-out replication across prompts
mechanism.detail: Require held-out replication across prompts, seeds, checkpoints, and relevant transformations.

mechanism.label: Activation patching ablation
mechanism.detail: Use activation patching, ablation, steering, counterfactual replacement, and negative controls to challenge causal claims.

proof_targets: In the finite policy model, no interpretability… may only preserve, restrict, escalate, or reject.
